name: preset_canvas_studio
first_used: films/chakra-redline v4 (2026-10-20), "Yeah, it's a nice edit"
default_for: talking-head edits, 16:9 long-form and samples, unless another preset is named

format.render: 1080p for previews and samples; 4K only for a final he asks for

type.headline: Schibsted Grotesk 800, -0.02em: 42-52 px on cards, 44 px panel titles
type.label: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next 700: 32-37 px (source lines 32 px)
type.hero: Archivo Condensed 900 caps, fill 96-1824 px (6.12 em for GRINDING DSA -> 282 px)
type.page: the real capture; the highlighter on his line

speaker.rule: never cut out: full screen or a closed shape (circle r = w/2, square, rounded card r 36) with his graded room
speaker.ring: 2 px white + 4 px violet 55 % + 42 px rose glow

motion.chart: keys: flat part on landing, creep through hesitations, fall from the noun, land on the last word (pop + ring)
motion.no_two_alike: whip / push through / hard cut / overview / morph

facts: every claim card: checked by search, a dated source line, <= 6 words; nothing unsourced

audio.voice: WPE dereverb when the room echoes, then DeepFilterNet3
audio.bed: one calm long-form bed (kit/music/calm, or one marked longform in kit/music/library.json), 18 dB under the voice on long-form and 12 on Reels (kit/film/mix.py defaults); v11 (films from 2026-10-22): it ducks on his voice and lifts only in pauses of 0.8 s or more (gap = under + 6), loops on its own phrases to fill the film and ends on the track's ending; HF.quiet dip (-10) on the hero line
audio.bed_opt_in: that v11 sound comes from kit/film's mix (python -m kit.film <film> mix). templates/build.py calls kit.audio.mix directly and stays on the v10 mix (Bed(under=-16, gap=-8), the word-mask duck, no loop, the old cue thinning) until it opts in: mix(..., sound=V11) (V11_REEL on 9:16) with Bed(..., under=-18, gap=-12, duck='voice'), and for a track shorter than the film segments=kit.audio.loop.plan(file, entry, start, need)['segments']

cues.asked_per_min: about 10-12 (v11: mix.py keeps 4-8 small cues a minute on long-form, 6-12 on Reels; each pop or whoosh rotates 2-3 loudness-matched files, no file over 25 % of the cues or 4 a minute; story sounds and keep cues always play)
